mapper.select: select mn.*, p.P_Name as pName, d.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, p.P_Build_Year as pBuildYear from challenge_plan_annual mn left join pre_project p on mn.p_id = p.P_ID left join sys_department d on d.D_ID = p.P_Competent_Department where mn.declare_year = #{params.declareYear} limit #{offset},#{params.size}
